title: ShatterQuant: Breaking Uniform Precision with Block-Wise Mixed-Precision on a Systolic Transformer Hardware Accelerator
abstract: arXiv:2610.00207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Due to limited support for intra-tensor heterogeneous precision in conventional accelerators, neural network quantization remains largely restricted to per-tensor precision assignment. We present ShatterQuant, a hardware-software co-designed framework enabling mixed-precision quantization within each tensor by assigning independent bit-widths to blocks of a weight projection. ShatterQuant couples precision granularity with PE configuration, such that each precision determines an effective block height. We introduce (1) a hardware-aware post-training method that assigns intra-tensor precision based on block-level standard deviation and weight sensitivity; (2) the ShatterQuant Transformer Accelerator supporting 1/2/4/8-bit weight precision, precision-dependent PE configuration, block rescaling, and integrated softmax and piecewise-linear nonlinearities; and (3) an evaluation of model-hardware tradeoffs using an implementation in the TSMC

translated_title: ShatterQuant：在脉动式Transformer硬件加速器上通过块级混合精度打破统一精度
translated_abstract: 由于传统加速器对张量内异构精度支持有限，神经网络量化在很大程度上仍局限于按张量进行精度分配。我们提出了ShatterQuant，这是一个软硬件协同设计框架，通过为权重投影的各个块分配独立的位宽，实现张量内部的混合精度量化。ShatterQuant将精度粒度与PE配置相耦合，使每个精度决定一个有效的块高度。我们的贡献包括：（1）一种硬件感知的后训练方法，基于块级标准差和权重敏感度来分配张量内精度；（2）ShatterQuant Transformer加速器，支持1/2/4/8位权重精度、精度相关的PE配置、块重缩放以及集成的softmax和分段线性非线性运算；（3）基于TSMC实现的模型-硬件权衡评估。
tldr: ShatterQuant提出了一种软硬件协同设计框架，通过块级混合精度量化和支持1/2/4/8位权重精度的脉动式Transformer加速器，突破了传统按张量统一精度量化的限制。
en_tdlr: ShatterQuant presents a hardware-software co-designed framework that breaks uniform precision quantization by enabling block-wise mixed-precision within tensors, coupled with a systolic Transformer accelerator supporting 1/2/4/8-bit weight precisions.
